title: After the midterms, is the AI industry in for a rough two years?
summary: Democrats’ historic victories in this week’s U.S. midterm elections could also transform the tech industry. The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the majority voted to impose more restrictions on data center development. And even when data centers weren’t on the ballot directly, they were a […]
llm_summary: Democrats’ sweeping wins in the recent U.S. midterms are set to tighten the regulatory landscape for tech infrastructure, especially data centers. Voters approved 40 out of 41 ballot measures that impose new limits on where and how data centers can be built, and even related measures that don’t mention data centers directly are expected to increase scrutiny. As a result, the AI and broader tech industries may face a tougher, more restrictive environment for the next couple of years
